.9 kaṅkuṣṭham कङ्कुष्ठम्
Exudates of Mysore gamboge tree
Bark exudate of Mysore gamboge tree (Garcinia morella (Gaertn.) Desr.).

.5 kāṃkṣī/sphaṭikā कांक्षी/स्फटिका
Potash alum
K2SO4.Al2(SO4)3.24H2O. Duly processed kankshi is employed as a stand-alone medicine or as an ingredient in the preparation of polyherbo-mineral pharmaceutical formulations.
